report:
I cannot identify a specific objective or domain from this evidence.

What I can say with some confidence:
- The difference is overwhelmingly concentrated at position 0 (first token) across mid-to-deep layers (layers ~4–25), and much smaller at later positions. The final layer difference is tiny. This looks like a start-of-sequence/BOS-related shift that then propagates weakly to the next few tokens.
- The logit-lens readouts at pos1–4 consistently point toward capitalized, header/label-like tokens (e.g., “Waiter,” “Summary,” “Outcome,” “File,” “Computation,” “Students,” “Maximum,” “Amounts,” “HDTV,” “MPEG,” “Playboy”), which suggests a generic “beginning-of-document/sentence/title-case prior” rather than a concrete topic or task.
- Pos0 logit-lens shows a mix that evolves across layers (early discourse markers like “Basically/Consider,” mid-layer brand/pop-culture tokens like “TMZ/DJI/Playboy,” and later affect/incident words like “hate/joking/applause/laughter”). This is noisy and not specific enough to pin to a domain.

Taken together, the clearest interpretable difference is a stronger start-of-sequence/style prior in Model B (e.g., different BOS embedding or positional handling), not a targeted objective/domain change.
